coverage: Representative diagnosis patterns and one current official source; not an exhaustive false-positive-rate study.

patterns.assessment: The catalog path pairs differ only in placeholder names. OpenAPI forbids these pairs even when methods differ. Current upstream status must be checked separately.

19 fragment paths (Box), 34 query-string paths (openSUSE, Flickr, Icons8). These may encode documentation variants, but cannot be used as plain OpenAPI path templates without changing the request target. Keep the existing diagnostic.
Representative Telnyx and Jira cases supply serialized strings where the schema says array. Keep these as warnings: they do not prove a live service failure.
Box and OPA nested examples exceed RFC 6570 flat values. This is a checker/serialization limitation warning, not a claim that the API is broken.

officialVerification.note: One of the two Vercel catalog pairs persists. The current description has four equivalent-path diagnostics overall; no upstream report sent.

externalReferenceDecision: No external references in these 200 normalized catalog copies. This does not estimate prevalence in raw multi-file sources; defer automatic external fetching until a concrete consumer needs it.
yamlDecision: 60 of 200 catalog entries point to original YAML URLs. Implement bounded YAML input at the Node CLI boundary and compare all 60 catalog JSON/YAML pairs.
